Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner introduced an unfounded criterion (“earliest U.S. availability”) and incorrectly claimed Ulti Ganga’s date as May 12, 2016, despite prior evidence (Wikipedia/IMDb) showing Ulti Ganga is a 1942 film. This ignored the gathered data and led to the wrong conclusion that I Am Breathing (2013) came out earlier.
